title: Men's Welder – I Basically Hot Glue Metal Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Welding Zip Up Hoodie – I Basically Hot Glue Metal
seo.description: A welding zip up hoodie: I BASICALLY HOT GLUE METAL. on the back over a welder and flying sparks, plus stitched HOT GLUE lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This welding zip up hoodie is for the welder who describes his trade as hot gluing metal, zipped on for the shop floor and the drive home after a long shift.

A welder in an orange helmet and a blue work jacket kneels over a steel beam throwing white sparks, a toolbox beside him, in orange, blue, cream and rust with a worn print texture. I BASICALLY runs above it and HOT GLUE METAL. below in two lines of heavy wide slab capitals: cream and orange on Black and Navy, navy and burnt orange on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small HOT over GLUE wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the word ARC is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest HOT GLUE wordmark and left-cuff ARC, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the I Basically Hot Glue Metal zip hoodie fit?
The I Basically Hot Glue Metal welding zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this welding hoodie warm enough for cold fab shops?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold fab shops, early shifts and the drive home after a long weld well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, I BASICALLY above the welder and HOT GLUE METAL. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small HOT over GLUE wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and ARC is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The HOT GLUE wordmark on the chest and the ARC cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a welder, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the welder who sums up the whole trade as hot glue for metal. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
